Alex / Marissa —

Attaching a preliminary cost workbook and a quick model showing committed vs on-demand economics for the profile you shared. Key notes:
- Committed tier (12-month) yields ~32% unit cost reduction vs current on-demand at 3M tokens/day profile.
- Add-on burst pool: metered pool with priority routing during spikes — charged as a 20% uplift to committed unit price when used, with rollover credits for unused burst capacity.
- Option to shorten term to 6 months with a smaller commit yields ~18% reduction.

Operational considerations (Irene, please flag): prefilling KV cache and session pinning on the busiest routes will reduce perceived latency during bursts; we'll need 48-72h for a targeted cache warm-up plan.

Attachments: HelioWorks_MAPlist.xlsx, Redwood_price_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx
